city.name: Akihabara
city.description: Akihabara's Electric Town from open data, lit by the real sun: Chuo-dori's signs, the station's Electric Town exit, Kanda Myojin up the hill, and Nikolai-do over Ochanomizu.

tour.title: Akihabara, from open data
tour.text: {buildings} buildings. {share:plateau}% of the footprint area stands at a height Project PLATEAU surveyed, on GSI's 5 m laser-scanned bare earth.

tour.title: Electric Town after dark
tour.text: Chuo-dori from Manseibashi to Suehirocho: radio parts after the war, then computers, games and anime. The signs and prints here are typical of the street, not its real shops'.

tour.title: Up the hill
tour.text: West of the tracks the ground rises to the Kanda heights: Kanda Myojin's gate, and Nikolai-do's green dome over Ochanomizu.

minor_labels: マーチ エキュート 神田万世橋

shore.encoding: r: 128 + 2 x signed distance to the shoreline (m, water positive); g: sand; b: rock

seawall.note: The rivers' and the bay's revetments and the castle moats: granite blocks and concrete.

trees.note: Species are not mapped. Elms stand for the zelkovas of Kanda Myojin's grove, plane trees for Chuo-dori's and Kuramaebashi-dori's street trees. A guess, not a survey.

water_bridges.name: 万世橋

water_bridges.name: 昌平橋

sources.heights: MLIT Project PLATEAU Tokyo 23 wards LOD2 building models (CC BY 4.0), as vector tiles by indigo-lab (MIT)
sources.buildings: Overture Maps Foundation, release 2026-10-21.0 (OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL; Microsoft ML Buildings, ODbL)
sources.terrain: GSI Fundamental Geospatial Data DEM5A, 5 m airborne laser survey bare earth (GSI terms of use); 10 m DEM where 5A is absent
sources.imagery: Geospatial Information Authority of Japan (GSI) seamless aerial photographs (GSI terms of use, source attribution)
sources.trees: Overture base land, tree points and rows (OpenStreetMap, ODbL); heights not mapped
sources.landmarks: Kanda Myojin's Zuishinmon (1975) on OpenStreetMap's footprint, its proportions from photographs; Nikolai-do's dome (about 35 m to the cross; Japanese Orthodox Church) on its drum. Electric Town's signs and prints are indicative: typical trades and invented adverts, no real shops' signs or logos.
sources.fonts: Signs drawn with Google Fonts under the SIL Open Font License: Zen Kaku Gothic New, Dela Gothic One, M PLUS Rounded 1c, DotGothic16, Bebas Neue, Reggae One, Shippori Mincho

woods.encoding: r: ground cover under the canopy (0-255), g: canopy height x 8 (m), b: a footway under the canopy, a: in a wood or park
